node.title: Re: regex not matching how I want it to :(
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I would very much recommend not parsing HTML with regular expressions - see [id://1201438]. For example, see [mod://HTML::LinkExtor]:

use HTML::LinkExtor; my $p = HTML::LinkExtor->new(); $p->parse_file("test.html"); my @hrefs = map { {@$_[1..$#$_]}->{href} } $p->links;

On your sample data, @hrefs is ("test1.htm", "test2.htm", "test3.htm").
